initial_gap: The secondary analyzer accepted model costs supported only by syntactically valid, even nonexistent, invoice and rate-card digests. It also did not open audit, reference, injection, human-event, or wall-event source bytes.

local_contract.inputs: existing schedule, receipts, Q assembly, secondary JSON and private content-addressed blobs directory
local_contract.source_bytes: reference, audit, injection when recovery is measured, human events, wall event and invoice for each measured run, plus the rate card
local_contract.model_cost: one exact invoice line per declared provider request including external retries, Decimal token-pricing calculation against a supplied model/version rate card, exact comparison with declared model and total USD
local_contract.nonmodel_cost: nonzero tool and human charges rejected by this narrow profile
local_contract.limits: 64 MiB per JSON input and blob, 4096 distinct blobs, 512 MiB aggregate blob bytes

negative_controls: rehashed invoice with false amount despite byte-hash match
declared total lower than receipt-derived model amount
external-failure retry with unbilled provider request
missing, altered, extra or symlink source blob
nonzero tool charge outside narrow profile
caller mutation of receipts during blob read cannot rebind invoice to unvalidated data

gates.result: 1331 passed, 1 xfailed in 129.75s after the source and MCP changes

initial_findings: API input mutation between validation and calculation could rebind invoice to unvalidated request IDs
exact rate-card model set falsely rejected extra unused rates
CLI JSON input had no preparse size limit
independent_review.final_reproductions: All three cases were closed: mutating caller input fails, unused rate succeeds, exact input size passes and excess fails. Reviewer found no other actionable local cost/retry issue and reported 106 related tests passing.

limits: Opened reference, audit, injection, human and wall bytes are not interpreted or compared with their claimed metric contents.
The supplied receipt usage, rate authority, invoice origin, zero tool/human expense and external custody are not authenticated.
The profile assumes one price per model/version and does not cover effort, time or other provider charges.
Jointly forged receipts, rates and invoice extracts can pass this local arithmetic check.
The supplied directory can change after its final scan; no independent immutable source or confirmatory matrix was used.
